output.summary: The evidence points to the temporary venue, not repertoire, as the main driver. Revenue fell in a step in 2023-24, when concerts moved to Brightwater, and single-ticket sales fell 45%. Cathedral concerts downtown sold 1,520 tickets against 1,027 at Brightwater. Exit surveys cite travel and parking far more than programming. Post-1945 programs sell the same as other programs in the same venue, and engaged subscribers renew at a stable 85-86%. Peers also fell about 29%, so the venue's share of the loss is confounded. Marketing and price effects are untested. Non-renewal would put the $1.2M key-person grant at risk and punish the wrong party. Cutting new works would jeopardize the $180k State Arts Council grant. Present the segmented analysis and use the cathedral dates and a shuttle.
